name: Tom Cotton
stance: AI-as-national-security hawk: export controls on advanced compute, bans on Chinese AI models over embedded backdoors, and keeping the U.S. ahead on frontier models — safeguards framed through security, not consumer regulation.

statements.text: Asked the Commerce Department to begin implementing provisions of his Chip Security Act to prevent large-scale smuggling of advanced AI chips to China after a DOJ smuggling indictment.
Communist China and its accomplices continue to smuggle advanced AI chips to undermine the US and threaten our national security.

Wrote to Commerce Secretary Lutnick urging a strategy to counter China's AI diffusion — strict export controls on advanced compute and semiconductor manufacturing equipment, and a government-wide ban on contractor use of Chinese AI models.
Backdoors may be embedded into open weight Chinese models, and auditing produces limited assurances.

we should continue to deny Communist China the frontier and limit its ability to serve customers on a global scale by enacting and enforcing strict export controls on advanced compute and semiconductor manufacturing equipment.
